disposition_reason: The source has a genuine FDE prediction endpoint, but the published numeric baseline, exact fold/cohort mapping and scalar comparison are unrecovered. The existing signed-motif implementation cannot establish stronger-than-paper neural prediction.

source_paper.title: Specialized structure of neural population codes in parietal cortex outputs

evidence.locator: Results: Vine copula models to analyze encoding in multivariate neural and behavioral data; Fig. 2b,c; Extended Data Fig. 1g
evidence.supports: Frame-by-frame neural response prediction is an ordered endpoint; FDE is displayed as a distribution. The paper reports ten mice and 59 sessions.

evidence.locator: Methods: NPvC models of single-neuron activity, Eq. 6 and following two paragraphs; calcium-imaging preprocessing
evidence.supports: Defines conditional inputs, OASIS deconvolution, fivefold fitting, five task epochs, eight trial types, minimum trial support and model-specific deviance normalization.
Author repository supplies NPvC, glmnet and simulation comparisons. Its README does not establish a complete real-data Figure 2 evaluation or historical fold ledger.
Names Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/NL1CAQ as the original data source; this does not authenticate the release-to-session mapping.

target.description: Predict held-out single-neuron deconvolved PPC activity conditional on the original task and movement variables, preserving Figure 2b,c. Larger motif enrichment or interaction information is not itself better predictive performance.

dataset.description: Original source deposit is doi:10.7910/DVN/NL1CAQ. The registration records release 1.0 and 70 files, but the bounded primary metadata request was denied; no authenticated file-to-Figure-2 mapping was recovered.

cohort.description: Paper reports ten mice and 59 sessions, with ACC-, RSC-, contralateral-PPC-projecting and unlabeled neurons. FDE uses sessions with at least five trials in every one of eight trial types. Exact eligible neurons/sessions and their animal joins remain unrecovered.

split.description: Source uses fivefold cross-validation for fit evaluation and bandwidth fitting. Original fold assignments and the precise time-point versus whole-trial assignment implementation have not been recovered; a whole-mouse holdout changes the task.

inputs.description: Time; virtual heading; lateral/forward running velocities and accelerations; trial type defined by sample cue, test cue and correct/incorrect outcome. Preserve all five original event epochs and the original conditional information boundary.

preprocessing.description: Paper describes OASIS AR1 deconvolution with cell-specific decay and epochs from -0.5 to +2 seconds around sample, delay, test, turn and reward. Exact release fields, trial alignment, and real-data fit construction are not yet bound to an executable baseline.

metric.description: Eq. 6 FDE=(L_model-L_null)/(L_sat-L_null), using held-out log-likelihoods. NPvC null uses the marginal activity density and its saturated term uses the peak over the source 200-point activity grid. GLM and NPvC have distinct source normalizers; preserve and audit those conventions rather than silently sharing a denominator.

aggregation.description: Figure 2c reports neuronwise FDE cumulative distributions; no exact numeric aggregate or complete per-neuron panel was recovered. A newly selected average, favorable projection subgroup or neuron count cannot substitute for the published comparison.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 2 held-out fraction of deviance explained, with original per-neuron support and source normalization

published_baseline.description: Published Figure 2c is an FDE distribution; an exact numeric source baseline and aggregate comparison rule have not been recovered. No value was digitized or invented.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No real-data author rerun was executed or established. The simulation README and deterministic signed-graph component are not a reproduced Figure 2 baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful FDE gain must be justified after recovering the original per-neuron distribution and baseline variability; no universal margin is supplied.

uncertainty.method: Recover the original model-comparison and resampling design, then predeclare a paired analysis respecting neurons nested within sessions and mice.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse for biological replication; original neuronwise corpus metric retained separately.
uncertainty.rationale: Triplets, cells, folds and time points cannot become independent mice. Exact animal/session mapping is needed before selecting an uncertainty rule.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact Figure 2 support, folds, fitted source preprocessing, likelihood normalizers and numeric NPvC baseline.
Compare candidate and author NPvC on the same original held-out observations and declared primary aggregation, with a justified effect and uncertainty rule frozen before final evaluation.
Retain GLM and original NPvC as separate baselines; beating GLM alone does not surpass the paper's NPvC result.
Do not reward higher motif enrichment, stronger p-values, graph-calculation fidelity, changed epochs or a held-animal extension as the same-task paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was verified; source-paper results and any future author rerun remain separate comparators.

episode.improvement_loop: Not admitted until original FDE evaluation is recovered. Then expose only the source-compatible training and internal validation information for iterative candidate development.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze code, hyperparameters, transforms, permitted inputs, fold ledger, metric and aggregation before the untouched original final predictions are scored.
episode.final_evaluation: One complete original-support Figure 2 comparison to the verified author baseline; any new split is reported only as an extension.
episode.baseline_policy: Published FDE distribution, reproduced NPvC and GLM, and any future current-SOTA claim are distinct. Historical motif reconstruction is calibration only.

blocking_issues: Exact Figure 2 per-neuron numeric baseline and original aggregation are missing.
The 70-file registration inventory is not an authenticated 59-session/ten-mouse eligible-cohort ledger.
Original folds and real-data source execution route are unresolved.
Meaningful effect, uncertainty, fixed access/compute budgets and full evaluator admission are incomplete.

legacy.notes: Preserve implementations/signed-motifs unchanged. It computes exact supplied-graph triplet statistics and finite two-pool probabilities, supplies no authentic graph cohort or fitted NPvC, and is calibration only; it is not a Figures 2-6 improvement evaluator.
